findings.title: Hover quick-actions overlay intercepts clicks when invisible (opacity:0 with hit-testing on)
findings.repro: WDIO `element click intercepted` failures (4 specs). When a test moves cursor into the card the overlay is opacity:0 but the absolute z-10 overlay still hit-tests. e.stopPropagation in the overlay's onClick (line 33) swallows the click intended for the card.
findings.fix_hint: Add `pointer-events-none group-hover:pointer-events-auto` to the overlay wrapper className. Keeps the fade-in animation but disables hit-testing when invisible. One-line change.

findings.title: Expanded card clipped by orchestrator panel at 1024px and fully covered at 375px
findings.repro: Resize window to 1024×768 + click a task — the Estimate input + Changes/Commits sub-sections clip mid-line. At 375×667 the expanded card is fully hidden behind the agent panel.
findings.fix_hint: (a) When expanding a task below `lg` breakpoint, auto-collapse the docked agent panel (set ui-store collapsed=true). (b) Add min-w-0 on the expanded-card parent so it can shrink without overflow.

findings.title: Workspace tab label collides with right-side icon cluster at 375px
findings.repro: Resize to 375×667. The centered 'Demo Workspace 1' visually overlaps with ShowArchivedButton + CostBadge icons. See docs/audits/2026-05-14/screenshots/wdio/board-default-mobile.png.
findings.fix_hint: At <sm: reduce max-w-[120px] to max-w-[64px], hide active-task badge, collapse the right-cluster (only Settings + Cost stay visible — others go into a `...` overflow menu).

findings.title: Agent panel header (Transcript/Terminal toggle, Hold/Stop/Kill) off-screen on mobile
findings.repro: Resize to 375×667 + open a task. Header shows title + path but the segmented view toggle and the Hold/Stop/Kill buttons are pushed off the right edge with no horizontal scroll affordance.
findings.fix_hint: Wrap PanelHeader to a second row below `lg`: put viewSlot + rightSlot on their own row OR hide workdir below `sm` to free space. The Stop/Kill must remain reachable.

findings.title: Settings drawer missing role="dialog" + aria-modal — SRs don't announce modal context
findings.repro: Open Settings (Cmd+,). Playwright snapshot confirms wrapper renders as <generic> with no role; backdrop missing aria-hidden. Screen readers report no modal entry/exit.
findings.fix_hint:
Add role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="settings-title" to the motion.div panel; add id="settings-title" to the

Settings

; aria-hidden="true" on the backdrop motion.div.

findings.title: No focus trap or initial-focus management — Tab leaks into background board
findings.repro: Open Settings → Tab repeatedly. Focus leaves the drawer and lands on background board buttons (Add task / Run All) sitting behind the dimmed backdrop.
findings.fix_hint: On isOpen, focus the close button (ref + .focus() in useEffect at line 147). Wrap content with a focus-trap (focus-trap-react, or hand-rolled keydown handler that loops Tab/Shift+Tab between first and last interactive elements).

findings.title: REGRESSION:P1-2 — Orchestrator sidebar-mode icon buttons missing aria-label
findings.repro: Tab into the orchestrator panel — the four sidebar-mode toggle buttons (History, Files, Pipeline dashboard, Pipeline v2 dashboard) have no aria-label (Dashboard and v2 only have `title`).
findings.fix_hint: Add aria-label={sidebarMode === 'history' ? 'Hide history' : 'Show history'} and equivalents. Keep `title` for hover tooltip.

findings.title: Workspace tab close button missing from tab bar (still)
findings.where: src/components/layout/tab-bar.tsx:44-117 (SortableTab — onClose prop accepted in TabProps but not rendered)
findings.repro: Hover any workspace tab in the tab bar — there's no close (X) icon, no right-click menu close, no keyboard close affordance. Only via the workspace's Cmd+W or Settings > Workspace > Delete.
findings.fix_hint: Render a hover-revealed close button inside SortableTab when tabs.length > 1 (preserve the implicit 'cannot close last tab' rule). Add a two-step confirmation dialog before deletion to prevent accidents.
findings.judgment_note: Some apps deliberately omit tab-close to force flow through Settings. But UX_AUDIT 2026-05-12 explicitly logged this as P0. Defer the rename/close decision but at minimum add a hover-revealed close button with confirm dialog.

findings.title: Card title reserves pr-24 (96px) for hover overlay even when overlay is hidden — wastes title width
findings.repro: On any card at 300px column width, titles wrap to two lines because effective title area is ~140px (300 − 24 padding − 96 reservation − misc).
findings.fix_hint: Drop pr-24 from the title; apply pr only on group-hover (`group-hover:pr-24`) — or position TaskQuickActions absolutely so it doesn't reflow the title row.

findings.title: Quick-action icon buttons are 24×24px — below 44×44 WCAG touch-target
findings.repro: Hover a task card → four 24×24 icon buttons stacked at top-right. On touchpads they're tight; on touch devices they fail SC 2.5.5.
findings.fix_hint: Bump to h-7 w-7 (28px) plus inner SVG h-4 w-4. Low-priority on desktop per ACCESSIBILITY_FINDINGS.md but the change is trivial.

findings.title: Workspace tab focus ring missing — keyboard focus indistinguishable from inactive state
findings.repro: Tab into tab bar → tabs render `role="button" tabIndex={0}` divs but with no focus-visible:ring style. Keyboard users can't see which tab is focused vs active.
findings.fix_hint: Add `focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-accent focus-visible:ring-offset-1 focus-visible:ring-offset-surface focus:outline-none` to the inner div className.

findings.title: Sidebar mode toggle buttons missing aria-pressed
findings.repro: Same buttons as P1-G. They are pressed-state toggles (highlighted when active) but expose no aria-pressed to screen readers.
findings.fix_hint: Add aria-pressed={sidebarMode === 'history'} (etc.) to each of the four mode toggle buttons.

findings.title: Color swatches have no focus ring — keyboard selection invisible
findings.repro: Tab into the color radiogroup in column config General tab. Selection moves but no visible focus indicator.
findings.fix_hint: Add `focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-accent focus-visible:ring-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-surface focus:outline-none` to the swatch button className.

findings.title: Color radiogroup not arrow-navigable; 10 swatches all in tab order
findings.repro: Tab through column-config General. Each color swatch is its own tab stop — 10 tab stops in one radiogroup. ARIA Authoring Practices requires roving tabindex + arrow-key navigation.
findings.fix_hint: Roving tabindex: tabIndex={color === c ? 0 : -1} + onKeyDown(ArrowLeft/Right/Up/Down → focus next radio). Same pattern as the triplet tabs already in this dialog at lines 189-231.

findings.title: Duplicate-looking rows: `?` and `Cmd+/` both labeled "Open keyboard shortcuts"
findings.repro: Open shortcuts modal (`?`). Two consecutive rows show the same description with different keys — reads like a list bug.
findings.fix_hint: Combine alt keys onto one row: `{ keys: ['?', 'or', 'Cmd', '/'] }` (or render the two key alternatives separated by 'or'). Same for Del/Backspace.

findings.title: SettingRow <label> not bound via htmlFor — clicking label doesn't focus input
findings.repro: In any Settings tab, click the bold label text next to an input (e.g. "Default base branch"). Focus does not move to the input. Already called out in ACCESSIBILITY_FINDINGS.md.
findings.fix_hint: Accept an optional `htmlFor` prop on SettingRow (or generate a useId, pass via context). Render `<label htmlFor={id}>` and clone the child to apply id={id}.

findings.title: "Refresh" looks like body copy — no border / icon / button affordance
findings.repro: Settings → Batches header. Refresh is plain secondary text with no button styling. Users miss it.
findings.fix_hint: Promote to a secondary button (border-border-default + bg-surface) or add a refresh icon. Match agent-tab.tsx's "Check for new models" button pattern.

findings.title: Push-to-talk toggle looks active when parent toggle is off
findings.repro: Settings → Voice. Toggle 'Enable voice input' off. The Push-to-talk row's toggle remains in the accent (checked) color at opacity-50 — misleads users into thinking PTT is still on.
findings.fix_hint: When parent toggle is OFF, force-render dependent toggles as `checked=false` OR add an explicit disabled-track style in Toggle when disabled+checked (neutral gray track, collapsed thumb).

findings.title: "Upcoming providers" rows fail contrast (opacity-50 + text-text-secondary)
findings.repro: Settings → Models & Limits → expand Upcoming providers. Each card uses opacity-50 wrapper + text-text-secondary on name and description. Stacked produces effective gray-on-gray that fails WCAG AA.
findings.fix_hint: Drop opacity-50. Use text-text-primary on the name + text-text-secondary/60 on the description. Add a "Coming soon" pill so the disabled affordance is clear without relying on visual fade.

findings.title: Terminal host div has no role / aria-label — SR users get unlabeled region
findings.repro: Tab into Terminal pane in agent panel. The xterm host has no semantic role or label.
findings.fix_hint: Add role="region" aria-label={`Agent terminal for task ${taskId}`} to the wrapper at line 267. Optionally aria-live="polite" on empty-state container.

findings.title: Command palette has no recents/quick-actions on empty search — long Navigation list dominates
findings.repro: Open Cmd+K with no search. Long list of 'Go to task: …' rows fills the panel. Standard practice (Linear/Raycast/VSCode) shows recents/pinned first.
findings.fix_hint: When !search, surface a 'Quick actions' group (Create task / Open settings / Switch workspace) above the Navigation list — or limit Navigation to 5 + 'Show all'.
